name: medguide-ai
description: A production-structured MERN MVC health guidance application with local MongoDB and server-side OpenRouter AI.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:server: node --test test/ai-service.test.js test/app.test.js test/auth-service.test.js test/chat-service.test.js test/config.test.js test/http-middleware.test.js test/models.test.js test/mongo-repository.test.js test/native-mongodb.test.js test/speech-service.test.js
scripts.test:watch: node --test --watch test/ai-service.test.js test/app.test.js test/auth-service.test.js test/chat-service.test.js test/config.test.js test/http-middleware.test.js test/models.test.js test/mongo-repository.test.js test/native-mongodb.test.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
